1 CHRONICLES CHAPTER 14

Hiram’s kindness to David, 1Ch 14:1.

His felicity in people, wives, and children, 1Ch 14:2-7.

His two victories against the Philistines, 1Ch 14:8-17.
e: David perceived, by the remembrance of God’s promise, and his providence complying with it, &c. But of this and the following verses, See Poole "2Sa 5:12", &c., where the same history is related.
Into all lands, i.e. into all the neighbouring countries.
